title: HDB Household Composition and Distribution
summary: An exploration of household composition using a public gov.sg dataset and a Jupyter Notebook.
overview: I used this analysis to become more familiar with Python data tools, including NumPy and Matplotlib.
approach: The notebook includes a box plot comparing household-size percentages across ethnic groups. The visualization was created with Pandas and Matplotlib.
imageAlt: Jupyter Notebook screenshot showing a box plot of household-size percentages by ethnic group
caption: A box plot from the household composition analysis.
